note: DERIVED by research-agent on 2026-11-12. ADDED means 'implemented anew in minidon-rust'. External behaviour of every capability is UNCHANGED: each delta is a new implementation of the same 82 baseline rules, not a behaviour change. Rule counts are from .mw/context/capabilities/*/rules-trace.md.

deltas.summary: Reimplemented in Rust with identical behaviour (14 rules): registration, first-registrant-becomes-Admin, PBKDF2 verification of existing hashes, 30-day tokens, profile limits. Identity resolution (get_by_username) shape is an ADR (OQ-018).

Reimplemented in Rust with identical behaviour (15 rules): follow, unfollow, follow requests, block (deletes follows both ways), mute, relationship. The shared social queries module is an ADR (OQ-005).

Reimplemented in Rust with identical behaviour (20 rules): compose, 60-minute edit window, soft delete with cascading boost removal, replies, boost only public and unlisted, favourite, 30 original posts per rolling hour.
Reimplemented in Rust with identical behaviour (8 rules): home, public, tag and account timelines with 20 default and 40 maximum page size.

Reimplemented in Rust with identical behaviour (10 rules in rules-trace; baseline.json index says 9, see CON-002): suppression for self, blocks and mutes; 40 default and 80 maximum list size; unread count and read marking.

Reimplemented in Rust with identical behaviour (15 rules): reports with 1000-character comments, resolve actions, suspension (revokes all tokens, hides account and statuses), staff hierarchy, role changes. How it deletes a status is an ADR (OQ-017).

platform.component: Shared infrastructure (minidon/main.py, __main__.py, models.py, config.py, db.py, deps.py, errors.py)
platform.summary: Not owned by a capability (Platform/Core in baseline.json coverage.unmappedPaths) but observable: app wiring of the six routers, DomainError to HTTP status mapping (400, 401, 403, 404, 422), auth dependencies, configuration and SQLite access. Rebuilt in Rust with the same behaviour.

notPorted.summary: Orphaned and unreachable (CF-002); its tables are never created. Not ported, per DEMO answer OQ-021. No external behaviour is lost.
